class.name: QuantumDarwinismChannelSpec
class.brief_description: Defines a factored Godot-reflection or semantic property channel for Quantum Darwinism outward wavefront generation.
class.description: Configures a single einselection channel propagated across `ProceduralEnvironment` topologies (parent-to-child, child-to-parent, siblings, and graph/spatial edges). Supports reflected properties, ClassDB archetypes, groups/tags, nuclear/peripheral semes, method/signal traits, and custom traits with `IdeamUndoRedo` commit wrappers.

members.member: Canonical reflection symbol or semantic name for this channel.
Godot-canvas aspect represented by this channel (ReflectedProperty:0, ClassArchetype:1, GroupOrTag:2, NuclearSeme:3, PeripheralSeme:4, MethodTrait:5, SignalTrait:6, CustomTrait:7).
Bitmask controlling which relational topologies propagate this channel (HierarchyDown, HierarchyUp, Siblings, GraphOrSpatial).
Baseline propagation permeability gamma_k across edges.
